description: AHGestimation is an R package for fitting at-a-station hydraulic geometry relations from river measurements. The JOSS paper describes robust fitting, outlier filters and mass-conservation checks for width, depth and velocity against discharge. Its own repository identifies the package and MIT licence. Spatial coverage is a measured reach or set of reaches, and temporal coverage follows the observation record supplied by the user. The fitted relations can be used to parameterize hydraulic routing and flood forecasts, including large-scale river models. A caveat is that a relation fitted at one cross-section may fail after channel change or outside observed flow ranges. Mass conservation in the fit does not remove measurement errors. The package does not supply a universal river geometry dataset. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article and own README were read without processing USGS or NOAA measurements.
name: AHGestimation river hydraulic geometry
